selection_policy: All markets in the longest continuous archived ETH5M run at a fixed snapshot, ending at least 15 minutes before selection. No outcome, price, performance, quality or trade-count filtering; ties choose latest run.
clock_contract: Exact BTC feed V1: L2 receivedMs in Unix ns; real matches executedAt plus mid half-second offset. No native replay.
